summary: Feed s066_single is degraded: 20.6% of TCP sessions are one-way (35/170 exceeds 10% threshold). NDR requires bidirectional traffic for session reassembly. All other checks (duplicates, encryption, VLAN, oversize, drops, overload, truncation, tunnel) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker/TAP is delivering only one direction for ~1 in 5 sessions to this NDR port. Most likely SPAN/mirror is configured for a single direction, or the broker is splitting client->server and server->client across different tool ports / not aggregating asymmetric paths to s066_single. SPAN oversubscription can also appear as one-way.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs_both_directions=true and needs_full_payload=true to reassemble TCP, track state, and detect C2, lateral movement and exfiltration. With 20.6% one-way flows the NDR creates incomplete flow records, cannot correlate request/response, and will miss detections / generate false incomplete-handshake alerts.

recommended_fix.why: Aggregate both directions of each 5-tuple to the same NDR tool port using symmetric hashing and verify TAP/SPAN captures both RX and TX. Restores complete bidirectional sessions required for NDR detection coverage.
